\subsection*{Gaussian Space --- Invariance --- Third Moments: Results}

\begin{theorem}[Three-norm bound for a product measure]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.affine_product_three_norm_sq}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.affine_product_three_norm_sq}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
Let $\tau$ be a measure on $\mathbb R\times\mathbb R$, let $\nu$ be an $\sigma$-finite
measure on $\mathbb R$, and let $\rho\in\mathbb R$. Suppose that for all $a,b\in\mathbb
R$, $\|x\mapsto a+bx\|_{L^3(\nu)}^2\le a^2+(b/\rho)^2$. Then, for the product measure
$\tau\times\nu$, $\|((u,v),w)\mapsto u+vw\|_{L^3(\tau\times\nu)}^2\le \|(u,v)\mapsto
u\|_{L^3(\tau)}^2+\|(u,v)\mapsto v/\rho\|_{L^3(\tau)}^2$, where the norms are
extended-valued.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Affine norm bound under independence]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.independent_affine_three_norm_sq}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.independent_affine_three_norm_sq}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.affine_product_three_norm_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive.affine_three_norm_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm}
\difficulty{5}
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $A,D,X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and let
$\rho\in\mathbb R$. Suppose $A$ and $D$ belong to $L^3(\mu)$, $X$ has
$(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractivity, $0<\rho$, the mean of $X$ is zero, and its second
moment is one. If $X$ is independent of the pair $(A,D)$, then $N_3(A+DX)^2\le
N_3(A)^2+N_3(D/\rho)^2$, where $N_3$ is the real-valued random-variable norm.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Third Moment Bound from the Third Norm]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.third_moment_le_of_three_norm_sq}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.third_moment_le_of_three_norm_sq}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm_rpow}
\difficulty{3}
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a measurable space, let $Z:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ belong to
$L^3(\mu)$, and let $B\ge 0$. If $N_3(Z)^2\le B$, where $N_3$ is the real-valued
random-variable norm, then $\int_\Omega |Z(\omega)|^3\,d\mu(\omega)\le B^{3/2}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Three-norm bound for multilinear polynomials]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.polynomial_three_norm_sq}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.polynomial_three_norm_sq}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinateDerivative, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinateDerivative_coeff, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinateDerivative_degree, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.independent_affine_three_norm_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.indep_sum_of_notMem, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.monomial_memLp_nat, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.multilinear_sum_insert, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm_const, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm_const_mul, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.HasDegreeAtMost}
\difficulty{6}
Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $F$ be a real
coefficient family on the subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ whose coefficients vanish on
sets of cardinality greater than $k$. Suppose $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ are independent real
random variables, each with mean $0$ and second moment $1$, and that each $X_i$ is
$(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive for some $0<\rho<1$. Then the square of the real-valued
$L^3$ norm of the random-input multilinear evaluation of $F$ is at most
$(1/\rho)^{2k}\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}F(S)^2$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Third moment bound for multilinear polynomials]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.polynomial_abs_third_moment}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.polynomial_abs_third_moment}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.polynomial_three_norm_sq, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.third_moment_le_of_three_norm_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV_memLp_nat, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.HasDegreeAtMost}
\difficulty{3}
Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $F$ be a real
coefficient family on the subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ whose coefficients vanish on
sets of size greater than $k$. Suppose the random variables $X_i:\Omega\to\bbr$ are
independent, and for some $0<\rho<1$ each $X_i$ is $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive, has
mean zero, and has second moment one. Then
\[
\int_\Omega |F(X)(\omega)|^3\,d\mu(\omega)
\le \left(\frac{1}{\rho}\right)^{3k}
\left(\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}} F(S)^2\right)^{3/2},
\]
where $F(X)$ is the random-input multilinear evaluation of $F$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Third moment bound for a coordinate derivative]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinate_abs_third_moment}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinate_abs_third_moment}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinateDerivative, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinateFree, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.eval_coordinate_split, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.polynomial_abs_third_moment, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.HasDegreeAtMost, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.eval, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.influence_eq_sum_fourier}
\difficulty{4}
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $F$ be a real coefficient family on
subsets of $[n]$ of degree at most $k$, and let $i\in[n]$. Suppose the random variables
$X_j:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ are mutually independent, $0<\rho<1$, and each $X_j$ is
$(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive. Suppose also that every $X_j$ has mean zero and second
moment one. Then
$\displaystyle\int_\Omega\left|X_i(\omega)\,D_iF(X(\omega))\right|^3\,d\mu(\omega)\leq
(1/\rho)^{3k}\,\mathrm{Inf}_i[F_{\mathrm{cube}}]^{3/2}$, where $D_iF$ denotes the
coefficient family formed from the Fourier coefficients of the Boolean-cube derivative
of $F$, evaluated at $X(\omega)$, and $F_{\mathrm{cube}}$ is the Walsh-basis evaluation
of $F$ on the Boolean cube.
\end{theorem}

\end{theorem}
